description: Source code for linenoise, a lightweight line editing library for UNIX-like systems, implementing command line input with features like history, completion, and multi-line editing.

classes.name: linenoiseState
classes.description: Structure representing the current state during line editing, including buffer, cursor position, prompt, terminal size, and history index.

classes.name: abuf
classes.description: Helper structure for buffering escape sequences during line refresh.

methods.name: linenoiseAtExit
methods.description: Cleanup function called at program exit to restore terminal state and free history.

methods.name: linenoiseHistoryAdd
methods.description: Adds a line to the command history.

methods.name: refreshLine
methods.description: Refreshes the current line display, choosing between single-line or multi-line mode.

methods.name: enableRawMode
methods.description: Enables raw terminal mode for immediate key input processing.

methods.name: getCursorPosition
methods.description: Queries terminal for current cursor position.

methods.name: linenoise
methods.description: Main API function to read a line with line editing features.
